why_now: The cell ships at NEAR_INDEPENDENT while never having been scored against GeT-RM. Its major allele *28 is a promoter TA-repeat; v0 substitutes rs887829 (*80) as an LD-tag proxy and claims 'EUR r^2 ~0.9+' WITHOUT ever measuring the tag against repeat truth. The repo has a demotion precedent for exactly this pattern (HLA B*58:01 tag: sens 0.61 / PPV 0.18 -> declared unsafe).

truth.independence: Multi-lab CDC consensus, independent of our caller. NOT a wet-lab phenotype -- it is the field's accepted reference diplotype. Tier bound is therefore agreement-with-reference, never correctness.
truth.vocabulary_note: Truth speaks in repeat alleles (*28/*36/*37/*60/*27/*6/*7) that the shipped SNP caller structurally cannot emit. Exact-diplotype concordance is therefore NOT a well-posed metric and is deliberately NOT the bar.

primary_metric.name: *28 carrier detection
primary_metric.definition: truth *28-carrier (any haplotype containing *28) vs predicted reduced-function carrier

secondary_metrics: *28 ZYGOSITY exact agreement (0/1/2 copies) -- the CPIC phenotype depends on zygosity, not carriership; a tag that gets carriership right and zygosity wrong still mis-assigns Poor Metabolizer
*6 concordance (rs4148323 is a direct SNP, so this is a like-for-like control on the non-tag half of the catalog)
per-superpopulation stratification (the catalog's STRUCTURAL_CAVEAT names non-EUR LD breakdown as a NAMED residual that has never been measured)

verdicts.tag_demote_and_disclose: overall sens < 0.80, OR sens < 0.80 in ANY superpopulation with n >= 10
verdicts.tag_partial: anything between -- report numbers, change no tier without ratification

direct_repeat_arm.claim_under_test: The catalog asserts the TA repeat is 'unresolvable from a short-read SNP VCF'. The 1000G 30x panel represents it at chr2:233760233 as indel alleles (C>CAT = +1 TA = *28; C>CATAT = +2 TA = *37; CAT>C = -1 TA = *36). This arm tests whether that asserted impossibility is TRUE FOR THIS PANEL.
direct_repeat_arm.status_if_untested: the impossibility claim stays as written; absence of this arm is not evidence for it
direct_repeat_arm.adopt_direct_over_tag: direct call STRICTLY DOMINATES -- sens >= tag AND ppv >= tag AND zygosity-exact >= tag, with at least one strictly greater
direct_repeat_arm.scope_limit_even_if_it_wins: A panel-specific result. It shows the repeat is callable FROM THE 1000G 30x PHASED PANEL, NOT that it is callable from an arbitrary short-read SNP VCF. Do NOT generalise to 'the structural wall is false'; the honest correction is 'the wall is panel-dependent and this panel clears it'.

disqualifiers.zero_carriers: if the overlap contains no truth *28 carriers the run REFUSES a verdict -- a tag cannot be tested against absent positives (the Oxford-zero shape)
disqualifiers.vacuous_arm: if the direct arm resolves 0 samples it is reported as unresolved, never as agreement

honest_limits_registered_in_advance: GeT-RM consensus is caller-derived, not wet-lab -- bounds agreement, never correctness
n=65 overlap; per-superpopulation strata will be small and several will be underpowered
*60 is a separate promoter SNP in LD with *28 and is NOT in our catalog; it is not scored as a miss
truth diplotypes carrying parenthesised/compound haplotypes are parsed per-haplotype; parse failures are counted and excluded, never silently defaulted
